confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Japanese prices and the supplied context, not from live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and budget-hotel anchors are less certain because Tottori has few hostels and little price data, so they carry wider ranges. Accommodation rates are also seasonal and vary with events. FX: the 0.6955 USD_PER_AUD observation for 2026-10-15 was taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as surfaced by search. The RBA F11 table was not opened directly, and the 2026-10-16 figure was not confirmed from an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against smaller Japanese prefectural capitals with modest tourism, such as Matsue and Tsu, rather than Tokyo, Kyoto or Osaka. Food and accommodation levels are adjusted to Tottori's lower urban costs.
